block-guide: CORE/PLAYLIST-TRACK One audio file in a core/playlist; it exists only inside one. See core/playlist for the full markup. A comment only, no HTML: <!-- wp:playlist-track {"id":123,"src":"https://example.com/wp-content/uploads/intro.mp3","album":"Demo","artist":"Studio band","length":"3:21","title":"Intro"} /--> id (the audio attachment id) is required: without it the track is not shown. src = the file URL; title (else "Unknown title"), artist, album, length "m:ss", image + imageAlt are text. Never write "blob": it is a temporary upload address used only inside the editor.
